title: 2605.12799v1
universal_lens: The synthesis of high-dimensional aquatic telemetry into actionable coaching directives is mathematically unified as a constrained projection operator. It maps continuous, noisy multivariate time-series from distributed IMU networks and physiological sensors onto a discrete, finite-dimensional latent space of biomechanical interventions, governed by strict physiological soundness constraints.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs conformal inference to bound the epistemic uncertainty of synthetic Question-Context-Answer triplets. By treating the multi-agent LLM as a probabilistic generator, we construct rigorous prediction sets for biomechanical anomalies, ensuring that automated coaching advice maintains calibrated confidence intervals despite severe data sparsity in edge-case aquatic environments.
gse_mapping: GSE models the swimmer's stroke cycle as a non-linear state-transition system. The RAG framework acts as a dynamic policy gradient, mapping raw kinematic spikes (e.g., acceleration vectors) to optimal periodization adjustments. This situational reasoning engine continuously updates the athlete's performance manifold based on real-time physiological anchors like HRV.

primitives.name: High-Frequency Kinematic Sensor Fusion Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: The proliferation of multi-axial inertial measurement units (IMUs), often deployed in distributed sensor networks across the swimmer's body, now enables the capture of micro-movements with unprecedented temporal resolution [1].
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \mathbf{a}(t): Acceleration vector (m/s^2); \boldsymbol{\omega}(t): Gyroscope angular velocity vector (rad/s); N: Number of IMU nodes (dimensionless); \Delta t: Sampling interval (s)
primitives.assumptions: Sensor noise is additive white Gaussian; rigid body dynamics apply between IMU attachment points; synchronization across the N-node network is perfect.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Signal-to-noise ratio drops below threshold during highly turbulent water entry/exit phases, or when hydrodynamic drag induces non-rigid deformation exceeding IMU mounting tolerances.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's spatial-temporal feature extraction layer, mapping raw physical displacements to abstract stroke mechanics.
layer2.telemetry: Peak acceleration magnitude and phase alignment variance across the 10-IMU network.

primitives.name: Biometric State Constraint Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: When coupled with real-time biometric tracking—measuring metrics such as heart rate variability (HRV), blood oxygen saturation via fNIRS, and metabolic markers—data sources even from regional-level swimmers have become remarkably pervasive [2].
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: HRV: Heart Rate Variability (ms^2 or dimensionless RMSSD); SpO_2: Blood oxygen saturation (%); VO_2max: Maximal oxygen consumption (ml/kg/min)
primitives.assumptions: Physiological responses are quasi-stationary over short stroke cycles; biometric sensors maintain stable contact despite aquatic immersion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs during extreme anaerobic thresholds where linear correlations between HRV and mechanical output collapse, or due to motion artifacts corrupting fNIRS signals.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSI's Bayesian physiological prior, constraining the generative model to only propose training loads within safe metabolic bounds.
layer2.telemetry: Real-time deviation of HRV from baseline resting state; localized tissue oxygenation gradients.

primitives.name: RAG-Based Expert Corpus Synthesis
primitives.verbatim_quote: Our proposed framework utilizes a multi-agent LLM architecture to synthesize a high-fidelity dataset of 1,864 validated "Question-Context-Answer" triplets — drawn from 1,914 drafts evaluated against 12 physiological soundness rules — meticulously mapping raw sensor spikes and physiological markers to evidence-based coaching interventions.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: T: Set of triplets (dimensionless count); R: Set of physiological rules (dimensionless); P(valid|draft): Probability of passing validation (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: The LLM possesses sufficient latent knowledge of swimming biomechanics; the 12 physiological rules form a complete basis for validating expert advice.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Hallucination regime: When the retrieval component fails to find relevant context for novel kinematic patterns, causing the generative agent to violate physiological soundness rules.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's decision-policy layer, translating fused multimodal states into discrete, actionable coaching directives.
layer2.telemetry: Validation pass rate (1864/1914); semantic similarity score between generated advice and ground-truth coaching manuals.

reasoning_traces.think:
The mathematical foundation of this aquatic intelligence system rests on the rigorous fusion of disparate data modalities into a coherent state-space representation. We begin with the high-frequency kinematic operator, which ingests continuous multivariate time-series from a distributed 10-IMU network. Mathematically, this constitutes a dense sampling of the swimmer's spatial trajectory and angular momentum in a 3D Euclidean space. However, raw kinematics alone are insufficient for holistic performance profiling; they must be coupled with the physiological state constraint kernel. This kernel introduces non-linear, time-dependent boundaries derived from HRV, VO2max, and metabolic markers, effectively carving out a feasible subspace within the broader kinematic manifold.

The core innovation lies in the RAG-based synthesis projection. Here, the continuous, high-dimensional state vector (comprising both kinematic and physiological elements) is mapped onto a discrete set of 'Question-Context-Answer' triplets. This mapping is not arbitrary; it is governed by a multi-agent LLM architecture acting as a sophisticated reasoning engine. The agents evaluate drafted interventions against a strict set of 12 physiological soundness rules. From a quantitative perspective, this process can be modeled as a constrained optimization problem: maximize the relevance and technical accuracy of the coaching advice (the objective function) subject to the hard constraints imposed by human physiology and biomechanical limits. The resulting corpus of 1,864 validated records represents a synthetic ground truth—a curated subset of the state space where every transition corresponds to a scientifically valid, evidence-based adjustment to the athlete's training periodization. This bridges the gap between raw data engineering and practical sports science, transforming an explosion of multivariate streams into a structured, trustworthy knowledge base for automated performance analysis.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This framework inherits its mathematical DNA from the convergence of two distinct lineages: classical biomechanical modeling and modern neuro-symbolic AI. Historically, swimming analysis relied on deterministic differential equations governing fluid-structure interaction and rigid body dynamics. Simultaneously, the evolution of Large Language Models introduced powerful, albeit stochastic, pattern recognition capabilities. The proposed RAG system represents a retrocausal synthesis, grounding the probabilistic outputs of contemporary AI in the rigorous, rule-based constraints of historical sports science literature and physiological databases.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: In this ecosystem, we model three primary decision actors: the Athlete, the System, and the Expert Validator. The Athlete acts as a dynamic physical system seeking to optimize performance metrics (e.g., stroke efficiency) while minimizing physiological fatigue. The AI System acts as an adaptive coach, observing the athlete's state and proposing interventions to guide them toward optimality. Crucially, the Expert Validator (embodied by the 12 physiological rules and human-in-the-loop checks) acts as an opposing force or regulator, vetoing any AI-generated advice that violates established biomechanical principles. This triadic interaction ensures the system remains aligned with human expertise.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: To prevent catastrophic failures, strict anti-collinearity and leakage vetoes are enforced across the layers. Specifically, we must ensure that the kinematic features do not trivially leak physiological outcomes without causal justification (e.g., a specific arm angle cannot deterministically dictate HRV without considering effort). Furthermore, the RAG synthesis layer includes a veto mechanism: if the retrieved context from the multimodal knowledge base is sparse or contradictory for a given kinematic spike, the generation of a triplet is halted. This prevents the propagation of hallucinated advice and maintains the integrity of the synthetic ground truth.
